messages:
mike: Heads up — main pipeline is red after merge, failing on packager-smoke step. Packager/upload shows repeated 502s in the logs. Anyone available to grab?

oncall-bot: ALERT: pipeline main #4821 failed on step packager-smoke. Logs: https://ci.redwood/inv/4821

sarah: @mike I can take a look, are there any infra changes in the last hour?

jess: I'm online, grabbing it now. Mike, which PR merged?

mike: Merged PR 1372 ~5m ago. No intentional infra changes that I know of.

jess: Doing a targeted retry for the packager step: `ci rerun --job packager-smoke --id 4821`

ci-bot: Rerun started: job 4821.rerun1. ETA ~3m

jess: Quick log tail shows: `.../packager: upload failed: dial tcp: connection reset by peer` and repeated `502 Bad Gateway` on the upload endpoint. Looks network-related so far.

alex: Can we bisect to narrow it down? Proposal: `git bisect start HEAD~10 -- HEAD` and run the smoke in each step on a quick sandbox.

jess: I'll kick off a bisect on a sandbox node. If it points at PR1372 I'll propose a revert.

ci-bot: Rerun finished: 4821.rerun1 -> FAILED (packager upload 502)

sarah: fwiw I rolled a small packager VM image bump in infra/staging ~3h ago but did NOT deploy to prod. worth checking image tags in the failing job.

mike: tagging @sara? (meant @sarah) — good catch. If infra change is the culprit we should hold on reverting 1372 until we confirm.

jess: Bisect started against HEAD~10, will post a callout once a culprit commit is identified. If this continues to fail for >15m I'll escalate to oncall for a broader rollback plan.
